en: All done! The modifications should give us a little boost in speed, but I don't think she'll hold up to too much bumping.
By your command!
Good day, $c. What would you like?

No, $c, that is not all. The elite fighting forces of the opposition are commanded by the four Commanders of the base. Should you be able to strike a fatal and rapid blow to their Commanders, the elite line will falter. Their numbers dwindling to nothing!$B$BBut be warned, soldier; Commanders and Lieutenants are not to be trifled with or taken lightly. They earned those ranks...

Gryphons, eh? Never really cared for the beasts but to each their own.

You can find Dungar Longdrink on the rampart in the Trade District.
Look at that!  Someone is fighting Mushgog!

Time to relax, the Alliance be way behind us mon. We all done with our collectin' here, and the final polishes be goin' on things as we speak. When they get done over in their Ironforge, then we be thinkin' 'bout movin' all this stuff to Silithus. 'Til then, sit tight and maybe do some fishin'.
And crossing the line is the gnome car! The gnomes win!
It is not worth answering.
The Silverwing Sentinels shall be in your debt, $c.  You will find Elfarran, our battlemaster, inside Stormwind Keep, attending the boy-king's audience.  Goddess watch over you!
Now, only one step remains to rid us of the Soulflayer's threat...
We have all the copper bars that we need. Thank you for your assistance, $c. You might wanna help out with the other materials being collected here.
I cause you no trouble, boss.
Children of Madness - I release you upon this world!
Elune be with you, $c.
$n, I am in need of your help once again.
Hmm, it would seem Keever needs a new subject. If that fool Abernathy keeps taking Keever's subjects, Keever may have to have a word with him.
Wait!  It appears our lookout has spotted something.
Delicious!
I'm telling Mommy!
Innkeeper Pala will help you rest your body and spirit.  You can find her in the building just south of the bank on the lower rise.
Berte! Evalyn! It's getting dark. Come inside.
A fellow enthusiast, huh? Well, you just wait, we'll make a gearhead out of you in no time!

Talk about making the wrong investment!$B$BLord Valthalak's dark book of spells fetched a pretty penny in the black market.  It's too bad he didn't take too kindly to getting his possessions stolen.  That stinker got us even after he'd been dead for months!
What a bloody waste this is!
Soldiers of Stormpike, come to my aid! The beacon must be planted.
Mmm... I love my delicious Southshore stout.
Hmmm... only enchanters I know of around here work out of Stormwind.  Why don't you ask one of the guards up in Stormwind?
If it is my fate to fall, then my dying breath shall be take you with me!
I understand, my friend. I shall find someone to help your master. Go back to him now, or at least stay close.
The servants of sul will feast on your remains.
Vesprystus' hippogryphs will bear you swiftly to your destination.  Seek him out in Rut'theran Village, through the portal which lies in the western section of Darnassus.
$n, my duties are complete and I shall now take my leave.  Luck to you my $gfellow:lady;, and remember to keep the Bell, Wheel and Candle working!

Slow down, $r. The one you need to kill is already dead. Killing him again will serve no purpose. There are very few ways in which a lich can actually be destroyed and none of those means are available to you or I. That is why I have a plan. A plan that will have a very noticeable and real impact upon the Cult.
%s sighs.
In case it wasn't obvious, I'm not here for customer relations.
%s begins to search through the badges of fallen Stromgarde defenders...
